capabilities: Write daily text into the current daily note
Adjust a daily word target based on recent performance
Track streaks and grant earned rest days
Award points and achievements for writing milestones
Resume from a saved pickup line after finishing
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states it makes no network requests and stores progress in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build a daily writing habit with word targets, streak protection and rewards tied to writing in daily notes.

relations.evidence: its "Focused 25 min" lines in your daily notes count as Lantern sessions and hours of focus
